patch_description: Inspired by the prior annealers, but replaces blind random moves with a targeted "lift" step: repeatedly identify the single bottleneck triangle (smallest area) and analytically move its three vertices along the gradient of the signed area to inflate it, with backtracking line search and simplex projection. Annealing kicks only fire on stalls, so iterations are spent where the objective is binding. A strict non-degeneracy floor (min area > 0.5 * fallback value) plus multi-start over perturbed lattice seeds guarantees a valid, non-degenerate result, addressing the silent-zero failures of earlier generations.
